newsitem.title: USA: Valmont votes 2-for-1 split, hikes payout.
newsitem.headline: Valmont votes 2-for-1 split, hikes payout.

text.p: Valmont Industries Inc said Monday its directors have approved a two-for-one stock split, to be effected in the form of a stock dividend, and increased the company's quarterly cash dividend.
The second quarter cash dividend will be $0.05625 a share (post-split) payable on July 15, record June 27.
The dividend is an increase of 12.5 percent from the previous quarter's dividend, and indicates an annual rate of $0.225 per share (post-split).
The additional shares from the stock split will be issued on May 30, 1997 to shareholders of record on May 9, 1997.
After the split, Valmont will have about 27.4 million shares outstanding.
Valmont designs and makes poles, towers, and structures for lighting, communication, and utility markets. The company also makes mechanized agricultural irrigation equipment.
Shares of Valmont were trading up 3/4 to 39.
